description: Na₄Ge₅O₁₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.21 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (1.81 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing GeO₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. In the third Ge site, Ge is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Ge-O bond lengths are 1.95 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Ge atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ge atoms.
